preview_view_events.observation: Actual512 transparent preview: two offset hollow rounded squares show layered windows and a clear common central negative space, rather than a letter glyph. Two major geometric components.
Actual32px view: layered-square silhouette identifiable and central white/transparent opening still visible, but current32px source stroke becomes about2px and looks delicate.
Actual enlarged QA32 pixels: two orthogonal frames are individually traceable, overlap remains readable, central opening visible. Thicken stroke for more robust tiny outline.

Actual512 transparent preview: six tangential rounded bars form a radial hexagonal aperture, with large central negative space. True different radial geometry, looks more like a general seal than layered information.
Actual32px view: radial hexagon remains recognizable and large opening clear; semantically reads an aperture/seal.
Actual enlarged QA32 pixels: alternating ring segments produce a hexagonal perimeter; less direct stacked-window meaning.

choice_basis: Two offset windows express information layers while retaining a common negative space. The radial aperture is visually sound but reads as a generic seal. Actual32px preview shows A identifiable but strokes thin.
chronology: Both512 original previews and both32px QA thumbnails were actually viewed before recording this choice. Final code/assets have not yet been created.
